# `aitbc plugin create`

Create a brand plugin skeleton that PluginManager can load.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc plugin create [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--type` | text | `brand` | no | Plugin type (metadata only) |
| `--name` | text | — | yes | Plugin name |
| `--output` | text | `.` | no | Output directory |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc plugin create --name <name>
aitbc plugin create --name <name> --output json
```
